# Dinu Kurniawan Cahyadi — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Dinu Kurniawan Cahyadi, a Full-Stack Web Developer based in Indonesia. Specializes in React, Next.js, Laravel, and Node.js.

## Pages

- [Home](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/): Hero, current role, and contact links.
- [About](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#about): Bio, experience stats, location, and availability.
- [Education](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#education): Formal education timeline.
- [Experience](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#experience): Work history.
- [Skills](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#skills): Technologies and proficiency levels.
- [Certificates](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#certificates): BNSP and Dicoding credentials.
- [Projects](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#projects): Selected web applications with source and live links.
- [Contact](https://myportofolio.codeunchs.my.id/#contact): Contact form, email, and WhatsApp.

## Usage

Content may be indexed and cited with attribution to Dinu Kurniawan Cahyadi and a link to the site. Do not use the contact form to send unsolicited bulk messages.
